heading: About Me
description: I am a Software Engineering graduate from Toronto Metropolitan University with a passion for building highly scalable, well-architected systems.
My professional experience spans the entire stack—from optimizing enterprise C# and .NET backend services to developing polished, responsive web applications using React.

Whether I am deploying containerized microservices via Docker, fine-tuning my Linux workspace, or designing intricate world maps and mechanics for custom tabletop campaigns, I am driven by a love for complex problem-solving and clean design.
